title: Chat
description: Talk in groups for your member type and class. You're added automatically.
empty: You're not in any groups yet.
emptyHint: Once your member type and class are set, you'll join the matching groups automatically.

groupHints.TEACHERS: Everyone who teaches or taught at AIS
groupHints.COHORT: Students and graduates of this class
groupHints.COHORT_PARENTS: Parents of children in this class
groupHints.ADULTS: Members join on the April 1 after they turn 18

room.enterHint: Enter adds a new line; press Send to send (or Ctrl/⌘+Enter on a keyboard). Type @ to mention someone.
room.digest: Get a daily summary at 8 pm when there are unread messages
room.adminView: You're viewing as an admin (you can't post here)

errors.forbidden: You can't post in this group.
errors.invalid: Please write a message (up to 2000 characters).
errors.tooFast: You're sending too fast. Please wait a moment.
errors.generic: The message couldn't be sent. Please try again.

room.blockedNotice: You can't exchange messages with this member.

digest.subject: [AIS Alumni] You have unread chat messages
digest.text:
You have {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}} in your group chats.
Please open the app to read them.

new.title: New chat
new.hint: Chat one-to-one with members you follow and who follow you back.
new.empty: No one to chat with yet.
new.emptyHint: Once you follow each other, you can chat one-to-one.

errors.notFound: You can't chat with this member.
errors.notFriends: You can only chat with members who follow you back.
errors.blocked: You can't chat with this member.

mention.subject: [AIS Alumni] {name} mentioned you in a chat
mention.text:
{name} mentioned you in a chat.
Please open the app to read it.
